messages:
alex: Heads up — seeing a TTFT spike on /v1/generate around 22:12 UTC. 95th TTFT up from ~120ms -> ~360ms. Not correlating with QPS. Anyone else?
ben: same here. dashboard shows kernel_selector flipped a lot of short-seq requests to `fallback_int8_kernel`. That kernel's launch latency looks high for microbatches.
maria: also saw `kv_prefetch` add ~50-80ms on affected requests. stack shows memcpy stall in the prefetch path.
perfbot: CPU profile snapshot (5s sample) for run 1859005428: kernel_launch 42%, kv_copy 27%, batch_queue_wait 18%, user callbacks 5%, other 8%.
katie: can you share the prometheus query you used? I want to look per-route and by model_variant.
alex: the quick one I used: `sum(rate(ttft_ms_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le)` then `ttft_ms - decode_ms` to approximate kernel+kv. It's ugly without kernel labels.
ryan: we should add `kernel_variant` and `route` labels to the ttft histogram. right now ttft only has model+region which hides these flips. Also add `quantization` label.
katie: +1. and we should emit `kv_prefetch_ms` and `kernel_ms` as separate histograms. then decode_ms becomes: `ttft - kernel_ms - kv_prefetch_ms - queue_time_ms`.
ben: quick canary: bumped kernel_selector short_seq_threshold from 32 -> 48 on a canary pool. fallback invocations for short sequences dropped ~62%, 95th TTFT improved ~12% for those patterns.
maria: but watch out — some long sequences now choose a different microkernel path and decode time for those increased slightly. we'll need an A/B cost-quality check.
alex: proposed action items:
- Add label `kernel_variant` to ttft & related histograms
- Emit `kernel_ms` and `kv_prefetch_ms` histograms (with labels route, model_variant, kernel_variant, quantization)
- Sample full flamegraphs (5%) for route `/v1/generate` for 30m after deploy
- Add dashboard tile: per-route kernel_ms, kv_prefetch_ms p50/p95/p99 + split by kernel_variant
- Alert if kernel_variant share changes > 10% in 5m window
perfbot: created perf metrics PR: perf-metrics-pr-421. CI checks queued.
katie: small PromQL snippet to add to dashboard editors: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kernel_ms_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, kernel_variant))`
ryan: also tag traces/spans with `kernel_variant` and `kv_prefetch=true/false` so jaeger+trace UI show attribution.
alex: I'll open the PR for metric changes + dashboard mock. assigning canary verification to @ben and regression checks to @maria.
ben: ack. will run canary and push comparison plots to /perf/runs/1859005432.
maria: I'll run synthetic benchmarks: combinations of short/long seqs, kv cache warm/cold, quantized/non-quantized to exercise selector heuristics.
alex: quick note: example metric emission pattern we discussed — simple gauge/histogram labels for clarity:
```
// pseudo
redwood_inference_ttft_ms{route="/v1/generate",model_variant="redwood-7b",kernel_variant="fast_f32",quantization="none"} <histogram>
redwood_inference_kernel_ms{...}
redwood_inference_kv_prefetch_ms{...}
```

katie: also suggest we keep low-cardinality for dashboards (route+kernel_variant+model_family) and push high-cardinality (api_key, user_id) into logs only.
perfbot: CI for perf-metrics-pr-421 passed unit tests. integration tests queued. ETA ~20m.
infra-bot: perf-metrics-pr-421 deployed to canary at 1859005540. status: ok.
ben: initial canary numbers (first 10k requests): fallback kernel invocations -62%, 95th TTFT from 360ms -> 240ms, CPU cost +3% per token. full dataset: /perf/runs/1859005432/summary.csv
maria: landed a small KV memcpy optimization in branch `kv-prefetch-opt`. Median kv_copy down ~35ms in microbench.
alex: perfect. follow-up: add automated alert that fires when kernel_variant composition for any route changes by >10% in a 5m window so we catch silent flips.
katie: will add alert rule to the dashboard PR.
ryan: +1. also recommend we run the new metrics for 48h and then decide permanent selector threshold changes.
alex: thanks all. if canary looks clean we'll roll to prod tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
